question: Which political leader won the bypoll election from Jubarajnagar constituency in Tripura, in June 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malina Debnath.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Malina Debnath:-**

 
 
• Malina Debnath is an Indian politician who is serving as Member of Tripura Legislative Assembly from Jubarajnagar Assembly constituency.
 
• She is a member of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP). Debnath joined the BJP in 2018.
 
• **She contested the Jubarajnagar Assembly constituency in the 2022 Tripura Assembly election and won by a margin of 4,572 votes. She took oath as MLA on June 28, 2022.​**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bandhu Tirkey:-**

 
 
• **He is an Indian politician who was a former Member of Jharkhand Legislative Assembly elected from Mandar of Jharkhand state as a member of Jharkhand Vikas Morcha (Prajatantrik) in 2019. **
 
• He was expelled from his post on Feb, 2022 for having more money than stated to ECI. He later joined Indian National Congress.
 
 
 
• **Rutuja Latke:-**
 
 
• **She is an Indian politician who is serving as Member of the 14th Maharashtra Legislative Assembly from Andheri East Assembly constituency. **
 
• She is the spouse of Ramesh Latke, who was the sitting MLA from the constituency before his death in May 2022.
 
 
 
• **Bishnu Sethi:-**
 
 
• **He was an Indian politician who served as the Deputy Leader of the Opposition in the Odisha Legislative Assembly from 2022 until his death in September 2022. **
 
• He was the MLA from the Dhamnagar Assembly constituency.
